decision: Place neutral skill under templates/apos/skills per existing registration guide; keep host and domain semantics outside package
rollback: Revert candidate commit; pinned consumers remain unchanged

recovery.decision: Restore verified skill bytes from a surviving Git copy; reconstruct schema changes explicitly as a new candidate; retain source hashes and distinguish recovered files from unavailable commits

publication.authority: Explicit user authorization to commit and merge
publication.decision: Publish recovered candidate via existing PR; preserve generic scope and Git ancestry; use merge commit so immutable consumer pins remain reachable
publication.verification: Compare tree hash, repository gates and exact-head CI before merge
